description: This file defines base classes and specific implementations for dimension-specific batch normalization modules in PyTorch's C++ API, including BatchNorm1d, BatchNorm2d, and BatchNorm3d, with methods for initialization, forward pass, and pretty printing.

classes.name: NormImplBase
classes.description: Base class template for all dimension-specific normalization modules, managing parameters, buffers, and reset logic.

classes.name: BatchNormImplBase
classes.description: Template class for dimension-specific batch normalization modules, providing forward pass and pretty print functionalities.

classes.name: BatchNorm1dImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for 1D batch normalization, inherits from BatchNormImplBase<1, BatchNorm1dImpl>.

classes.name: BatchNorm2dImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for 2D batch normalization, inherits from BatchNormImplBase<2, BatchNorm2dImpl>.

classes.name: BatchNorm3dImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for 3D batch normalization, inherits from BatchNormImplBase<3, BatchNorm3dImpl>.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets parameters and buffers, initializing weights and biases if affine, and resetting running stats.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs batch normalization on input tensor, considering training mode and running stats.

methods.name: pretty_print
methods.description: Outputs a formatted description of the batch normalization module.
